name: The Racing Crew
summary:
Step into the ultimate adrenaline rush with this fast-paced arcade racer, bringing high-speed thrills and intense drifting action straight to your Meta Quest. Feel the raw power of your engine as you tear through stunning, diverse environments designed to push your driving skills to the absolute limit.

Whether you are burning rubber on a sun-soaked coastal highway, kicking up sand in a vast desert, sliding across treacherous ice-covered mountain passes, or navigating the tight corners of an industrial ship
